# Universal Gameplay Ability System (UGAS)

> UGAS is an open, engine-agnostic specification for standardizing gameplay abilities, attributes, effects, and tags across game engines (Unreal, Unity, Godot) and AI world models. It defines a portable, data-driven architecture for gameplay logic.

The specification covers four pillars: Attributes (numeric state with a modifier pipeline), Gameplay Tags (hierarchical semantic labels), Gameplay Abilities (asynchronous stateful actions), and Gameplay Effects (the sole mutation mechanism for attributes and tags).

## Specification

- [UGAS Specification (Markdown)](v1.0.0-draft.4/SPEC.md): The full technical specification in Markdown format
- [UGAS Specification (HTML)](v1.0.0-draft.4/index.html): The full technical specification rendered as HTML
- [UGAS Specification (AsciiDoc)](v1.0.0-draft.4/SPEC.adoc): The full technical specification in AsciiDoc source format
- [Complete LLM context file](llms-full.txt): The entire specification plus all schema definitions and examples in a single file

## Schema Definitions

- [Gameplay Controller Schema](v1.0.0-draft.4/schemas/gameplay_controller.yaml): Central hub managing abilities, effects, attributes, and tags
- [Attribute Schema](v1.0.0-draft.4/schemas/attribute.yaml): Individual attribute definitions with base values, clamping, replication
- [Attribute Set Schema](v1.0.0-draft.4/schemas/attribute_set.yaml): Logical groupings of related attributes
- [Gameplay Effect Schema](v1.0.0-draft.4/schemas/gameplay_effect.yaml): Effects that modify attributes and grant tags/abilities
- [Gameplay Ability Schema](v1.0.0-draft.4/schemas/gameplay_ability.yaml): Ability definitions with tag-based activation rules
- [Gameplay Tag Schema](v1.0.0-draft.4/schemas/gameplay_tag.yaml): Tag registry for hierarchical semantic state labels

## Examples

- [Health Attribute](v1.0.0-draft.4/schemas/examples/health_attribute.yaml): Resource attribute with clamping
- [Damage Effect](v1.0.0-draft.4/schemas/examples/damage_effect.yaml): Instant effect that modifies Health
- [Fireball Ability](v1.0.0-draft.4/schemas/examples/fireball_ability.yaml): Offensive ability with tag requirements
- [Tag Registry](v1.0.0-draft.4/schemas/examples/tag_registry.yaml): Example tag hierarchy

## Genre Packs (templates)

Additive, copy-and-extend starter kits per genre: a genre spec that extends (never replaces) the core spec, plus schema-conformant template entities you can load directly.

- [Genre Packs index](v1.0.0-draft.4/genres/index.html): Navigable landing page listing every published genre pack
- [Genre taxonomy](v1.0.0-draft.4/genres/taxonomy.html): Non-normative map of game genres/subgenres that scopes the pack work
- [RPG pack spec](v1.0.0-draft.4/genres/rpg/spec.adoc): Role-Playing genre extension; template entities under v1.0.0-draft.4/genres/rpg/entities/
- [Racing pack spec](v1.0.0-draft.4/genres/racing/spec.adoc): Racing (Forza-style) genre extension; template entities under v1.0.0-draft.4/genres/racing/entities/
- [Action pack spec](v1.0.0-draft.4/genres/action/spec.adoc): Action / Action-Adventure genre extension; template entities under v1.0.0-draft.4/genres/action/entities/
